predecessor_evidence.interpretation: V23 proves that the persistent learned graph plus primary-pointer wide loop is broadly valuable. Its sole gate failure occurs on a path where five compile-time filters can still admit false survivors and therefore pay mismatch discovery before learned screening becomes useful. V24 adds one source-general cold-path filter after the same five-filter survival condition; it does not remove, route around, rename, or retime the failed case.

declared_design.summary: Retain the complete V23 control-flow and register contract. Only after all five authenticated static columns leave a nonempty candidate mask, lazily apply one sixth compile-time literal column before entering V23 mismatch discovery. An empty sixth-column intersection returns to the existing wide advance. A nonempty intersection enters the unchanged V23 learned-selection graph.
declared_design.scope: Every V23-admitted unanchored exact byte literal with width 6 through 32 and a cyclic-phase-unique five-column signature on AArch64 ASIMD.

sixth_column_selection.algorithm: Use the first remaining offset from the existing candidate_adaptive_offsets_v13 ordering after excluding the five manifest-authenticated offsets.
sixth_column_selection.ordering: Ascending frozen V7_BYTE_FREQUENCY_RANK for the literal byte, then ascending source offset.
requirements: The selected offset is in bounds.
The selected offset differs from primary, secondary, verification, quaternary, and quinary.
Every admitted width has at least one remaining offset because admission requires width at least 6 and five distinct authenticated offsets.
Selection depends only on immutable literal bytes and the existing authenticated offsets.
The failed width, topology, corpus row, observed timing, and runtime data are not inputs.
sixth_column_selection.wire_contract: The sixth offset is deterministically rebuilt from the literal and existing five-offset manifest. No prior wire field changes and no prior image changes.

unchanged_entry_and_hot_prefix: V23 literal broadcasts for the existing five static columns
V23 window checks and pointer-authoritative primary-wide loop
V23 primary-empty advance and both X5 reconstruction sites
V23 secondary-only transition and existing five-column refinement
new_cold_path: Reachable only after the existing five-column Q0/Q2/Q4/Q6 masks are nonempty.
Obtain the deterministic sixth offset during emission.
Load and broadcast the sixth literal byte lazily into Q24.
Load the four 16-byte sixth-column blocks into the existing Q18-Q21 scratch registers.
Intersect Q0/Q2/Q4/Q6 with the sixth-column equality masks.
If all four refined masks are empty, branch to the existing pointer-wide advance.
Otherwise branch to the unchanged V23 wide_learn_select label.
unchanged_learning_and_suffix: V23 mismatch candidate selection and exact confirmation
V23 learned byte Q24, learned offset Q25, and X11 state
V23 saved-mask recovery, narrow, scalar tail, and output ABI
q24_liveness: Q24 is dead before V23 mismatch discovery.
The sixth static broadcast is consumed before wide_learn_select.
V23 wide_learn_select overwrites Q24 with the discovered learned byte before any learned consumer.
No sixth-static edge reaches a learned consumer without that overwrite.

requirements: V24 adds no instruction or byte to emitted V1 through V23 images or any SVE/SVE2 image.
V24 adds no instruction to the primary-empty, pair-empty, or any earlier-static-empty steady-state path.
The sixth literal broadcast is lazy and occurs only after five-column survival.
No memory spill, new architectural register, runtime counter, or data-dependent dispatch is introduced.
All direct branches and relocations remain within authenticated AArch64 encodings.

required: Emitter/template byte-for-byte agreement and whole-image audit acceptance.
Version 37, magic 0x25, AOT, audit, runtime allowlist, mutation, and reseal rejection coverage.
Mechanical byte identity for every previously supported backend/image, including V23, against implementation commit 8fc126b78a14c7b4d4298fc465accbce891194fb.
Decoded proof that the sixth offset is the first remaining adaptive-ranked offset and is distinct/in-bounds for every frozen width/topology.
Decoded proof that the sixth filter is dominated by five-column survival and that sixth-empty reaches the unchanged wide advance.
Decoded liveness proof that Q24 is dead at sixth-static entry and overwritten with the learned byte before every learned consumer.
Mutation rejection for the sixth literal load offset, sixth column address, broadcast register, all four comparisons/intersections, and sixth-empty branch.
Semantic tests for sixth-empty, sixth-nonempty false survivor, exact match, later group, narrow, tail, and no-match exits.
Widths 6 through 32, zero and nonzero primary offsets, every unselected mismatch offset, modulo-16 boundaries, deterministic randomized windows, and left/right guard pages.
Independent local and EC2 C9g correctness receipts before any timing.

fresh_performance_gate.method: Paired portable/V17/V24; 12 repetitions; all 6 execution orders; approximately 4 ms target per measurement; semantic equality checked before and during timing.
fresh_performance_gate.membership: Exactly the frozen V23 lattice: widths 6..32, four topologies, six scenarios, three windows, 1,944 cells and 108 artifact pairs.
fresh_performance_gate.on_failure: Seal immutable refusal; do not retest, retune, reclassify, or deploy this identity.
fresh_performance_gate.on_success: Require independent review, a fresh formal qualification identity, held-out external corroboration, and production routing tests before deployment.

required_only_after_formal_success: Rebar-blind ripgrep/external literal workload families frozen independently of V24
long-running compiled Rebar corroboration only after production qualification
